objective: Design and land the Measurement Provenance Architecture (MPA v1): an ADDITIVE provenance spine binding every claim-bearing decision (FINDING / DECISION / PROMOTION / CLOSURE) to four typed origin slots - Evidence, Hypothesis, Measurement Contract, Measurement Execution - each carrying its own resolution class and witness. Splits the 2026-08-26 audit's single `originating_measurement_basis` slot into CONTRACT and EXECUTION, which is what makes declared-but-never-executed a first-class queryable state instead of the audit's U4 footnote. Ships a frozen design document, two frozen JSON schemas, an append-only committed ledger, a record builder/validator, a read-only resolver, six named+versioned derivation rules, a query/record CLI, and a 33-test floor. Backfill writes DERIVED or ATTESTED and NEVER EXPLICIT; enforcement is advisory-first with the Phase-4 gate deliberately NOT built. The findings architecture is not modified in any way.
change_class_rationale: No production behavior surface. Nothing in configs/production/ is read for control flow or written; ACTIVE_VERSION is untouched; no feature identity, formula, derived metric, dataset schema, model input/training/artifact, or runtime decision path changes. The three new modules live under src/governance/ and are reachable only from the new CLI and the test floor. JSONL_CLAIM_SURFACE_CHANGE covers the new committed append-only stream (configs/research/provenance_ledger.jsonl) and its two CC-* classes registered in the claim catalog.
rollback_boundary: Delete the three src/governance/provenance_*.py modules, the CLI, the two schemas, the ledger, the design doc, the test floor and both manifests; revert the jsonl_claim_catalog.yaml stream + two CC classes + one forbidden join and regenerate data/jsonl_claim_catalog.jsonl; remove the MEASUREMENT_PROVENANCE surface from closure_authority_index.json and its CLAUDE.md row; revert the grandfather pin 408->407 and the stub row. No production config, ACTIVE_VERSION, model, ontology node, feature, or finding is touched, so rollback is pure file removal. The ledger is append-only by contract: rolling it back means deleting an uncommitted file, not rewriting a published record.
authority_granted: User 2026-08-26 via approved plan: design a Measurement Provenance Architecture producing A-H (architecture, components, data model, JSON schemas, registry design, migration, backfill, governance impacts), constrained to additive design that does not modify the existing findings architecture, supports current repository governance and provenance-audit requirements, and distinguishes CURRENT from PROPOSED. Deliverable shape approved as 'design doc + reference implementation'; backfill posture approved as 'DERIVED + ATTESTED, never EXPLICIT'; enforcement posture approved as 'advisory-first with a dormant gate'.
authority_NOT_granted: No economic authority and no G001. `grants_authority` is const false on every record and pinned by a test. No finding's verdict, Confidence, Status, Contract, Family or Evidence field is altered - the findings architecture is READ, never written. No promotion, no config edit, no ACTIVE_VERSION change, no ontology node, no retrain, no measurement admissibility (the E4 seal still needs mt01 COMPLETE, coverage 0/27). The Phase-4 enforce gate is explicitly NOT built and no CI check fails on a MISSING provenance record. The audit extractor scripts/analysis/research_dag_provenance.py is NOT modified and must never read the ledger.
additive_only_proof: The four subject record systems are opened read-only: docs/current-findings.md, docs/governance/build_manifests/*.impact.json, configs/promotion_log.jsonl and docs/governance/closure_authority_index.json are parsed, never written by any provenance module. The one exception is closure_authority_index.json, which gains a NEW surface row for this surface itself - an addition to the index, not a modification of any existing surface. Subjects are addressed by their EXISTING natural keys (F-id, change_id, promotion-line timestamp, surface_id); this layer mints no identifiers for them.
